newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Monday amid covering of short positions ahead of settlement on Tuesday, dealers said.

They said a statement by Water and Power Minister Nisar Ali Khan ruling out termination of a power purchase agreement between Hub Power Co and state water and power utility also helped improve floor sentiment.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.19 points, or 0.66 percent, to end at 1,553.65. Losers led gainers 162 to 94. Turnover fell to 48 million shares from 49 million in the previous session.
PTCL rose 0.10 to 25.80 rupees, ICI Pakistan 0.05 to 24.50, Hub Power 0.45 to 37.80 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.10 to 36.10.
Pakistan State Oil rose 6.0 to 316, Fauji Fertilizer 1.75 to 84 and Sui Southern Gas rose 1.0 to 28.25
